image.note: LoadImage expects a filename inside the ComfyUI input folder (upload first). The body/source image (single-image mode: ImpactSwitch 790 select = 1). Feeds ImageResizeKJv2 657 -> FaceDetailer 722 and FaceBoundingBox 830. One image per run: the runner loops when the node fans out (`each`).

face.note: LoadImage expects a filename inside the ComfyUI input folder (upload first). The consented face reference. Feeds ImageResizeKJv2 809 -> TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus 807 (orientation match, KSampler 819) and ImpactSwitch 823 -> FaceBoundingBox 831 -> TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus 174. Binds once for every item of a batch.

prompt.note: Default 'Adjust the source image lighting and skin tone to ensure the new face fit in the new body seamlessly ...'. Leave empty to keep it.

negative.note: Empty by default; the negative of FaceDetailer 722, KSampler 819 and the bypassed UltimateSDUpscale 775.

seed.note: widgets_values: [guide_size 512, guide_size_for true, max_size 1024, seed, control 'fixed', steps 4, cfg 1, ...]. KSampler (Efficient) 819 widget 0 is the seed of the head-orientation pass and keeps its own value.

image.note: The FaceDetailer 722 result. SaveImage 827 is the bypassed UltimateSDUpscale pass (node 775, mode 4).

notes: Batch folder mode exists inside the workflow: LoadImageListFromDir //Inspire 787 (widget 0 = a folder path on the pod's disk) selected by ImpactSwitch 790 = 2. The engine binds the single image and loops per item instead, so every item has its own seed, manifest entry and group; the folder loader would hide the item list from the runner.
ImpactSwitch 823 = 2 routes the face through the orientation-match pass (KSampler 819, prompt 807 'Rotate the head for exact positional rotation'); set it to 1 to use the face reference as uploaded.
No batch count: EmptyLatentImage 808 batch_size only sizes the orientation pass; one output per run.
LoRAs: Qwen-Image-Lightning-4steps (89) and 1GIRL_QWEN_V3 at 0.51 (785) on qwen_image_edit_2509_fp8; face detector bbox/face_yolov8m.pt (723), insightface (829), 4xFaceUpDAT.pth (804).

Consent step: the runner refuses to run it unless every reference collection feeding it has collection.json with rights owned, licensed or fictional, and consent: true for a real person (docs/engine/BATCHES.md). Real faces only with a written release.
